name: Post-award payments from supplier to buyer-linked accounts
description: Winning supplier transfers funds to persons or companies connected to the procuring official shortly after payment.
fp: Supplier subcontracting may pay related parties innocently.

sources.text: OECD, Recommendation of the Council on Public Procurement (2015)
OECD, Preventing Corruption in Public Procurement (2016)
OECD, Guidelines for Fighting Bid Rigging in Public Procurement (2009)
FATF, Laundering the Proceeds of Corruption (2011)
